lead_customer.subject: VORA inquiry received - #$lead_id
lead_customer.html:
Dear $name,

Thank you for contacting VORA. Your $lead_type inquiry (#$lead_id) has been received. Our team will review the details and respond by email.

VORA | Freight & Logistics

invoice_customer.subject: VORA invoice $document_number
invoice_customer.html:
Dear $customer_name,

Please find attached invoice $document_number ($document_date).

Verify the document using the QR code in the PDF or the link: Verify invoice.

VORA | Freight & Logistics

receipt_customer.subject: VORA payment receipt $document_number
receipt_customer.html:
Dear $customer_name,

Your payment receipt $document_number is attached. Verify the document through the QR code or online verification.

VORA | Freight & Logistics

payment_confirmed.subject: VORA payment confirmation - $invoice_number
payment_confirmed.html:
Dear $customer_name,

We confirm that your payment of $payment_amount has been credited to PT Satu Arah International on $payment_date.

Invoice: $invoice_number
Payment reference: $payment_reference
Invoice status: $invoice_status
Outstanding balance: $outstanding_amount

For your records, the official receipt will be delivered separately when any required administrative formalities have been completed.

VORA | Freight & Logistics

quotation_approval_request.subject: VORA quotation approval requested - $document_number
quotation_approval_request.html:
Dear $customer_name,

Please review the attached quotation $document_number. You can download, sign and stamp the quotation and securely upload the signed PDF at the customer approval link.

Valid until: $valid_until. The approval link will expire on $approval_expiry.

VORA | Freight & Logistics

quotation_approved_admin.subject: VORA quotation accepted - $document_number
quotation_approved_admin.html: Quotation $document_number has been reviewed and approved by VORA Finance. A signed/stamped PDF is retained in the private document archive.

prepayment_receipt_customer.subject: VORA pre-payment receipt $document_number
prepayment_receipt_customer.html:
Dear $customer_name,

Please find attached the pre-payment receipt $document_number for invoice $invoice_number, prepared for your internal payment process.

It is not proof that payment has been made: VORA issues the official payment receipt once the funds are credited to its bank account. Verify the document through the QR code or online verification.

VORA | Freight & Logistics

delivery_received_customer.subject: VORA delivery $delivery_number received
delivery_received_customer.html:
Dear $consignee_name,

Your shipment $delivery_number has been delivered and received by $receiver_name on $received_at.

The proof of delivery, with the signature, photos, location and time of receipt, is available here: View the proof of delivery.

VORA | Freight & Logistics

delivery_received_admin.subject: VORA delivery $delivery_number received
delivery_received_admin.html:
Delivery $delivery_number to $consignee_name was received by $receiver_name on $received_at.

Open in admin: $delivery_number
